title: Review.
bodyText: All decisions and findings of the commissioner made under the provisions of this article shall be subject to review by proper proceedings in any court of competent jurisdiction in this State.
bodyHtml: §432:2-702  Review.  All decisions and findings of the commissioner made under the provisions of this article shall be subject to review by proper proceedings in any court of competent jurisdiction in this State. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2]
